lines: Next to the chat, the preview panel shows what the session is working on, in tabs, without leaving the conversation.
When the AI writes a draft, it opens the editor here. Editor tabs end with edit.
Open an item's deployed page to run it with its form, and see its triggers and its versions.
Each run opens as its own tab, with its logs and its result.
The picker opens any page of the workspace: runs, schedules, variables, resources, or the compare page. Draft badges show what this session changed.
Open it in the workspace to leave the session, or go full screen when you need the room.
